preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(a, int) and isinstance(b, int) and 1 <= a <= n <= 2000 and 1 <= b <= min(26, a) for n, a, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n, a, and b are integers satisfying 1 <= a <= n <= 2000 and 1 <= b <= min(26, a).

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, a, b in test_cases) <= 2000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s, (n, a, b) in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output string s has length n and consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(s[i:i+a])) == b for s, (n, a, b) in zip(output_lines, test_cases) for i in range(n - a + 1))
postconditions.description: For every test case, every substring of length a in the output string s contains exactly b distinct characters.
